bridgeAdapterPatches: Generation isolation for stale response detection
connectE2EE registers only devices without a server identity and waits for the encrypted socket
Credential login removed from the E2EE bridge; served by loginHelper

Page templates / XMA kept as structured template attachments with all CTAs + carousel items; legacy LSInsertAttachment rows converted; button templates (message text + CTA rows without a card) get a template with those buttons (bridge/xma.go orphanButtons, events.go)

fetchMessages RPC: per-thread history page via LightSpeed FetchMessagesTask, answered asynchronously; an existing-range answer must carry the request reference timestamp (as in mautrix-meta), one diagnostic log line per page (bridge/history.go)
E2EE: thumbs-up CommonSticker, image galleries, placeholders for view-once / payment / contact; signal-only payloads dropped instead of empty messages

loginHelper.reason: Separate module since fbchat-v2 2.3.2, whose pinned mautrix/meta 3ed7bfa crashed in the Bloks interpreter on Facebook's current Messenger Lite login pages (nil GetArg in bk.action.f32.Eq, missing bk.action.array.Get). The E2EE bridge now pins cea2e38 (2026-08-25), still older than the helper's v0.2609.1 (2026-10-08), so the helper keeps its own vendored copy (login/meta via a replace directive) with a small Bloks patch adding bk.action.string.StartsWith/EndsWith/Contains, which v0.2609.1 still lacks but the OTP input validation uses.

note: fbchat-v2 main at 2026-10-15 (not tagged yet): "fix(e2ee): stabilize LightSpeed bridge for v2.3.3" bumps mautrix/meta 3ed7bfa -> cea2e38. The old pin no longer completed the LightSpeed socket handshake ("failed to ensure db 1 is synced: timeout") on current Facebook accounts.
